data.name: Mansurat
data.gender_notes: Mansurat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has conquered or subdued something, often in battle, or one who is victorious and successful in life. The name Mansurat carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mansurat usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the inner strength and resilience of the soul, embodying the spirit of courage, determination, and victory over adversity.
data.etymology: Mansurat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mansurat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: منصورة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني النصر والتمكين من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: منصورة هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل 'نصر' الذي يعني في اللغة العربية النصرة والتمكين. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَكَانَ اللهُ عَزِيزًا مُنتَصِرًا' (النساء: 136). يدل الاسم على معنى النصر والفوز، ويعبر عن الصفات الحميدة مثل الشجاعة والتصميم.

in_urdu.name: منصورة
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے نصیرت اور اللہ تعالی کی طرف سے تائید
in_urdu.long_meaning: منصورة ایک علم اسم ہے، جو کہ 'نصر' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نصیرت اور تائید۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ اللہ تعالی کا ارشاد ہے: 'وَكَانَ اللهُ عَزِيزًا مُنتَصِرًا' (النساء: 136)। یہ نام النصر اور فوز کے معنی پر دلالت کرتا ہے، اور شجاعت، عزم اور پختگی جیسی خوبیاں ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मंसूरा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है विजय और ईश्वर की कृपा से सफलता
in_hindi.long_meaning: मंसूरा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'नस्र' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है विजय और सफलता। कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख है, जैसे कि अल्लाह का वचन: 'وَكَانَ اللهُ عَزِيزًا مُنتَصِرًا' (अल-निसा: 136)। यह नाम विजय और सफलता के अर्थ को दर्शाता है, और साहस, निश्चय और दृढ़ता जैसे गुणों को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: منصوره
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب دی بریا او د الله له خوا څخه ملاتړ
in_pashto.long_meaning: منصوره د ښځینه اسم دی، چې د 'نصر' فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې بریا او ملاتړ دی. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه د الله تعالی فرمان: 'وَكَانَ اللهُ عَزِيزًا مُنتَصِرًا' (النساء: 136). دا نوم د بریا او بریا په معنا دلالت کوي، او د صفاتو ښودنه کوي لکه زړورتیا، عزم او پختیا.

in_english.name: Mansurat
in_english.meaning: Name means victory and success with God's support
in_english.long_meaning: Mansurat is a feminine given name, derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-r' which means victory and success. It is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Allah's saying: 'And Allah is All-Powerful, All-Victorious' (Nisa: 136). The name signifies triumph, divine support, and conveys virtuous qualities like bravery, determination, and resilience. It symbolizes a person's aspiration for achievement and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mansurat holds great importance in Islamic history and culture, as it is associated with individuals who achieved significant victories and accomplishments. It serves as a reminder of the heroic deeds and struggle of those who came before us, inspiring hope and determination in the face of challenges. The name can also be seen as a symbol of resilience and strength, reflecting the enduring spirit of Muslims throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mansurat also has spiritual significance, as it can be seen as a reminder of the ultimate victory that awaits us in the hereafter. The Quran states that "parses" or "conquests" are among the blessings bestowed upon believers by Allah (Quran 4:74), and the name Mansurat can serve as a reminder of the spiritual conquest we must strive for in our lives. It is a reminder to remain steadfast in our faith and to continue striving towards righteousness and obedience to Allah, in the hopes of achieving the greatest Victory - entry into Jannah (heaven) and the eternal happiness and peace that come with it.
